parts.text: $VTRS: flat revenue but still losing money — Q3 net loss of $325M on $3.7B revenue, alongside $899M in operating cash flow. 👇 #earnings #pharma
$APD (preliminary): profit grew faster than sales as operating income jumped on project exits and pricing. Q4 FY26 revenue $3.6B (+12% Y/Y), operating margin 17.8%. 👇 #earnings #materials
$YUMC: Food and Non Food Revenues From Sales delivered 80% of the $271.0M revenue gain (+7% Y/Y). Q3 2026 revenue $3.5B (+8% Y/Y). Operating margin 13.0%. 👇 #earnings #restaurants
$TAP: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $460M, 169% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $3.4B (−2% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #beverages
$CI: sold more but kept less — revenue +6% to $73.7B, but operating profit fell 7%. Q3 margin slipped to 3.3%. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$SUNC: revenue growth sped up to +199% to $18.0B, while operating margin held at 4.1%. Q3 net earnings were $81M. 👇 #earnings #oil
$SUN: growth sped up to +199% from +164% the quarter before, reaching revenue of $18.0B in Q3 2026. Operating margin held at 4.1%. 👇 #earnings #oil
$DTE: revenue growth sped up to +6% to $3.7B, but costs grew faster and operating profit fell. Q3 net earnings up 12% to $470M. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$CVX: operating profit grew faster than sales, +152% vs +36% for Q3 2026. Revenue reached $67.8B with a 20.1% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #oil
$SRE: about 35¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, up from 20¢ a year ago. Q3 revenue $3.2B (+1% Y/Y). (preliminary) 👇 #earnings #utilities
$HTZ: sold more but kept less — revenue +6% to $2.6B, but operating profit fell 63% as costs outpaced sales. 👇 #earnings #EarningsSeason
$NSIT: sold more but kept less — revenue +22% to $2.4B, operating profit −26% (preliminary). Q3 costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #ecommerce
